consequence.statement: Compactor component now has memory limits enforced in Ksonnet-templated deployments, preventing unbounded memory usage.

original.statement: Loki Ksonnet introduces memory limits to the compactor configuration to avoid unbounded memory usage.

decision.reason: [ev-deb1f67af51d] says only that the Ksonnet compactor configuration now has memory limits "to avoid unbounded memory usage". It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, so a failure kind would over-claim. The deployment still works but with a new limit, which fits behavior-change (review) at low severity. The evidence says nothing about how the compactor behaves when it reaches the limit, so confidence is low.
